title: Parse a version string
hints: Write the shape as one pattern with named groups: major is required, minor, patch and build are each wrapped in an optional (?:...)? group.
Use pattern.fullmatch(s.strip()); a None result is your ValueError. re.match would accept trailing junk.
m.group('patch') is None when the group did not match; int(m.group('patch') or 0) gives the default. Remember to escape the parentheses around the build: \( ... \).
